changes: Shared confirmation prompts use 16-point margins, 12-point rounded frames, 24-point headings, 16-point body/button text and 40-point actions. Action rows stack according to measured label widths plus padding/strokes rather than a fixed threshold. Message height accounts for wrapped headings; long messages scroll with a reserved visible scrollbar. Caller-owned meanings, choices, Escape/backdrop cancellation and default focus are unchanged.

gui.scope: Full UI suite passes. Existing 1x/2x light/dark wide/compact tests cover long messages and unbroken paths, action bounds, stable footer during scrolling, exactly-once choices across repeated layout, Escape/backdrop cancellation, dirty-close preservation and interface switching.

gpu.scope: Twelve raw light/dark desktop/360x360 scenes show real dirty-document New, Close and interface-switch prompts. Each scene is cancelled and the document remains dirty.

checks: Formatting, whitespace and source file length checks passed.
limits: Shared app confirmation styling is consistent with current Classic surfaces but no native Paint confirmation close-up was supplied. Studio/shared consumers inherit the styling; exact native/historical parity and OS accessibility remain unqualified. No new save/discard workflow, auto-accept behavior or performance claim.
